app.name: maewmeet
app.description: See which days your friends are all free, and make plans in one place.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: Sign in with a username and a 6-digit PIN. No email needed.
signup.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: a–z, numbers, dots or underscores
signup.displayNameHint: Friends in your groups see this name. Up to 40 characters, any language.
signup.pinRemember: Keep your PIN somewhere safe. There’s no email to recover it, so if you forget it a system admin has to approve a reset.

pinChange.hintConfirm: Enter the same 6 digits once more

pinRules.title: What makes a valid PIN
pinRules.notRepeated: Not all the same digit, like 000000
pinRules.notSequence: Not a straight run, like 123456 or 654321
pinRules.why: That’s all it takes to rule out the easy guesses. Pick numbers you’ll remember but others won’t guess.

forgot.title: Forgot your PIN?
forgot.intro: Tell us your username. A system admin will check the request and let you set a new PIN.
forgot.deviceNote: Once it’s approved, sign in from this device. If you switch devices or clear your browser data, this request won’t work and you’ll need to send a new one.

pending.title: Request sent
pending.body: A system admin will review it, which can take a little while. If you remember your PIN in the meantime, just sign in as usual and the request is cancelled for you.
pending.hint: You can close this page and check back on the sign-in screen.
pending.expiry: If nobody answers within 7 days, the request expires and you can send a new one.

approved.title: Approved
approved.body: Sign in with your username and the PIN 123456, then set a new PIN right away.
approved.thisDevice: Works only on this device, the one you sent the request from.

closed.title: This request is closed
closed.body: It expired, was declined, or has already been used. You can send a new one.

setPin.title: Set a new PIN
setPin.intro: For your security, choose a new PIN before you carry on. 123456 can’t be used again.
setPin.doneOthers: Any other devices you were signed in on have been signed out.

adminResets.title: PIN reset requests
adminResets.warningTitle: Check with the owner before approving
adminResets.warningBody: Anyone who knows a username can ask for a reset in their name. Contact the owner outside the app, by chat or a call, and compare the time, device and country with what they tell you. If they don’t match, or they didn’t ask, decline.

approveSheet.title: Approve request from {username}
approveSheet.body: {username}’s PIN will become 123456 for 24 hours, on the device that sent the request only. Their old PIN stops working straight away.
approveSheet.check: I’ve confirmed with the account owner outside the app

rejectSheet.title: Decline request from {username}
rejectSheet.body: The request will be closed. Their current PIN keeps working.

empty.title: No requests waiting
empty.body: When someone taps Forgot PIN, their request shows up here.

me.title: Me
me.logoutAllHint: Signs you out on every device you’ve used, including this one.

logoutAllConfirm.title: Sign out everywhere?
logoutAllConfirm.body: You’ll need to sign in again on every device, this one included. Your current PIN still works.

pin.title: Change PIN
pin.done: PIN changed. Your other devices have been signed out.

line.title: LINE reminders
line.hint: On LINE, get a reminder before plans you’re going to, and a heads-up if one gets cancelled. The in-app bell still works too.
line.codeHint: Add the “แมวเจอกัน” account as a friend, then send this code in the chat. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
line.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect LINE? You’ll stop getting reminders there, but they’ll still show in the bell.
line.error: That didn’t work. Please try again in a moment.

help.admin: Can do everything in the group, including making moderators, handing over the admin role and deleting the group.
help.moderator: Can rename the group, set the free-time window and remove members.
help.member: Can add busy time, make plans and invite friends.

errors.VALIDATION: Some fields need a fix. Check the highlighted ones and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find that. It may have been deleted, or you’re no longer in that group.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do that. Ask a group admin if you think you should.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone changed this in the meantime. Reload to see the latest, then try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: That’s a lot at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: This is turned off for now. Try again later.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.AUTH_MAINTENANCE: Sign-in and sign-up are paused for maintenance. Your data is safe, and this won’t count as a wrong PIN. Try again later.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. If you think that’s a mistake, contact the system admin.
errors.PIN_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Set a new PIN to continue.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong username or PIN.{attemptsRemaining, plural, =0 {} =1 { One try left before a short lock.} other { # tries left.}}
errors.LOGIN_LOCKED: Too many tries. Try again in {retryAfterMin, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That username’s taken. Try another one.
errors.USERNAME_FORMAT: Usernames are 3–20 characters: a–z, 0–9, dots and underscores only.
errors.PIN_FORMAT: Your PIN needs to be exactly 6 digits, with no letters or spaces.
errors.PIN_MISMATCH: The PINs don’t match. Try again.
errors.PIN_TOO_WEAK: That PIN is easy to guess. All the same digit (like 000000) or a straight run (like 123456 or 654321) isn’t allowed. Try a different mix.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: We couldn’t verify that request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ADMIN_TRANSFER_REQUIRED: Make someone else the group admin first, then try again.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: This code doesn’t work. Ask someone in the group for a new one.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: That person’s already in this group.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: No one has that username. Check the spelling, or send them an invite code instead.
errors.LIMIT_REACHED: {limit, select, groups {You can create up to {max} groups. Delete one you no longer use to make a new one.} members {This group is full ({max} members at most). An admin can remove members who aren’t active.} codes {This group already has {max} active invite codes. Revoke one you don’t need to make a new one.} busyCount {You already have {max} upcoming busy entries, the most we allow. Delete ones you don’t need, then add this one.} busySpan {One entry can cover {max} days at most. Try splitting it into a few.} busyBackdate {You can add busy time up to {max} days back. Pick a more recent date.} appointments {This group already has {max} upcoming plans, the most we allow. Cancel one you don’t need to make a new one.} appointmentSpan {One plan can run {max} days at most. Try splitting it into a few.} appointmentsPerDay {You’ve already created {max} plans today, the most we allow. Try again tomorrow, or edit one you already have.} routines {You already have {max} routines running, the most we allow. Stop one you don’t need to add a new one.} routineRows {That would take your routine days past {max}. Try a shorter stretch or stop a routine you don’t need.} routineSpan {That stretch is longer than one routine can cover. Try splitting it into a few.} routineAhead {You can plan up to {max} months ahead. Pick an end that’s closer.} other {You’ve hit a limit. Free something up and try again.}}
errors.INVALID_RANGE: {kind, select, dates {The last day can’t come before the first day.} other {The end has to be after the start.}}
errors.INVALID_DATE: That date doesn’t exist (like 30 February). Pick one from the calendar.
errors.INVALID_LOCAL_TIME: That time doesn’t exist here because the clocks skip ahead. Pick another time.
errors.TIME_NOT_ON_STEP: Times go in half-hour steps, like 18:00 or 18:30.
errors.DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: That date is outside the range we support. Pick one from the calendar.
errors.RANGE_TOO_LARGE: That date range is too long. Try a shorter one.
errors.INVALID_TIMEZONE: We don’t recognise that time zone. Pick one from the list.
errors.INVALID_WINDOW: The group’s free-time hours don’t work. The end has to be after the start, and the window can’t be shorter than the minimum free stretch.
errors.INVALID_MAP_URL: We can’t read a location from that link. Try copying it from the Share button in your maps app.
errors.INVALID_COORDINATES: Those coordinates don’t look right. Check the latitude and longitude.
errors.APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED: This plan was cancelled, so it can’t be changed.
errors.APPOINTMENT_PAST: This plan is over, so answers are closed.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.draft: This page explains, based on how the app actually works, what we keep and how we use it. It isn’t a legal document.
privacy.intro: maewmeet is an app for making plans with friends. It keeps only what it needs to work, shows no ads, and never sells or shares your data for marketing.

collect.title: What we keep
collect.account: Your account: username, display name and PIN. The PIN is stored as a hash, so it can’t be turned back into the digits. We don’t ask for an email or phone number.
collect.busy: Busy time you add: dates and times, what you’re doing, and private notes.
collect.groups: The groups you’re in and your role, plans (title, time, place, map link and any coordinates), your replies to plans, and in-app notifications.
collect.security: Security data: your sign-ins on each device (including browser details), a wrong-PIN counter, per-IP rate counters stored as a hash rather than the IP itself, PIN reset requests (time, short device name, country), and a log of important actions (the audit log).
collect.cookies: Only the cookies the app needs: your sign-in (expires within 60 days of your last use), language, theme, and a device cookie when you request a PIN reset.

see.title: Who sees what
see.owner: You see all of your own busy time.
see.members: People in a group with you see when you’re busy, and what you’re doing only for entries you haven’t set to “Details hidden”. Hidden entries just show that you’re busy.
see.note: Private notes are never sent to anyone but you.
see.outsiders: People who aren’t in a group with you can’t see your busy time at all.
see.groups: Group members see your display name, your role, the group’s plans and replies to them.
see.superAdmin: System admins see usernames, display names, group memberships and counts so they can run the app, suspend or unlock accounts and approve PIN resets. A system admin can also open any group the way a member can (calendar, free days, plans with their title, time and place, invites) and manage it (edit or cancel plans, remove members, hand over group admin, delete the group). Every one of these is recorded in the audit log. System admins never see private notes, or what you’re doing for entries set to “Details hidden”.

places.title: Places and maps
places.links: The app doesn’t search for places or load map images for you. The place name and map link you enter are kept with the plan only. The “Google Maps” and “Apple Maps” buttons are plain links: the place name you typed is sent to that provider only when you tap the button yourself (if you haven’t typed a name, nothing is sent), and once it opens, the provider sees your device as with any website.
places.noTracking: No ads, and no third-party trackers or analytics.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.busy: Busy time that ended more than 90 days ago is deleted automatically.
retention.notifications: Notifications older than 90 days are deleted automatically.
retention.sessions: Sign-ins expire within 60 days of your last use.
retention.security: PIN reset requests and the audit log are kept for security, with no deletion date yet.
retention.groups: Groups and plans are kept until they’re deleted. A deleted group is hidden from its members, but system admins can still see its name and member list, and it isn’t removed from the database yet.
retention.providers: The app runs on outside hosting and database providers, so the data above is stored and processed by them.
retention.line: The linked LINE user ID is kept until you disconnect, delete your account, or unfollow our LINE account.

delete.title: Deleting your account
delete.how: You can do it yourself in the Me tab → “Delete account”, with your PIN. If you’re a group admin, hand over admin or delete the group first.
delete.removed: Removed or cleared: sign-ins on every device, membership in every group, all your busy time, your plan replies, your notifications, your PIN and display name, and the device and country details of your PIN reset requests. Invites you created and pending PIN reset requests are cancelled. Your old username becomes free for others to use.
delete.kept: Kept: plans you created (shown as created by “a former member or deleted account”), the audit log, invite and PIN reset rows reduced to their status, time and account ID, and the account record itself, marked as deleted with no name or PIN.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions, or want more removed than the delete button does? Reach a system admin through one of your groups, or ask whoever invited you to the app.

calendar.title: Adding a plan to your calendar
calendar.body: If you tap “Add to your calendar app” on a plan, data leaves the app only when you tap it yourself. If you choose Google Calendar, the plan’s title, time, time zone, place name, map link (if any) and plan link are sent to Google straight from your browser (not through our server). That data is in the URL, so it may stay in your browser history. If you choose the .ics file, the same details sit in a file on your device, though your calendar app may sync it on to your iCloud or Google account. The map link is the one added to the plan (or carried over from an older plan), and it may contain the place’s coordinates. If the plan has a map link, it goes in the entry’s URL field or its Location section, depending on your calendar app, and in the Details with the label “Map:”. The plan link goes in the Details with the label “See the plan in maewmeet:”. With no map link, the URL field is the plan link. The title and place may be text another member typed. We don’t send the plan’s details, coordinates on their own, group name or member names. Either way it’s a one-time copy: if the plan changes or is removed from the app, the entry in your calendar won’t change or disappear.

line.title: Messages on LINE
line.body: If you connect LINE, we send pre-plan reminders, and a message if a plan you said you’re going to is cancelled, there through LINE’s service. They contain only the plan title, date and time, group name and a link to the plan, and go only to you. No place, details or member names are sent. We keep your LINE user ID for this. You can disconnect any time from the Me tab. If you haven’t connected, nothing is sent to LINE.
